blocks.note: What holds the build together is discipline at the boundaries: every state change is replayable from the signed baseline across the Industry Use Cases estate, and rollback is rehearsed before go-live rather than after the incident.

blocks.x: Under the hood the pattern is a composition, not a monolith: 4 tower services, the Dataq Swarm platform for rails, and your estate at core systems for truth. Every boundary is a contract; every contract has an SLO and an owner.

items: Diagnose (2-4 weeks)
The design principle here is simple: cost and quality telemetry land in the same view your owners read in Industry Use Cases, so drift shows up as a ticket with an owner, not as a mystery.
Prove (6-10 weeks)

At operating tempo, the properties that carry the load are structural: the decision path and the audit path share one timeline across the Industry Use Cases estate, which keeps the blast radius of any change inside one lane.
Industrialize (1-3 quarters)
The engineering bet is explicit: identity is short-lived and authorization is deny-by-default in Data, Analytics & Lakehouse delivery, which keeps the blast radius of any change inside one lane.
Compound (ongoing)
Nothing in this topology is accidental: each stage owns its latency budget and its failure policy across the Industry Use Cases estate, so a regression is a cohort, never an estate.
